claim: Cloudflare announced and internally deployed ongoing Verified Bot behavior assessment, evaluating robots.txt compliance and response to HTTP 429 rate limits.
verifiedFacts: Cloudflare says it is already evaluating sustained bot behavior internally; its October 16 publication introduces explainable trust bands.
Public scores and customer-configurable thresholds are future plans, not established generally available features.
inference: Inference: Bot identity must not be confused with continued authorized behavior.
Consultancy implication and client problem: Agent compliance assessment: clients need proof automated traffic respects site policies.
Project disposition and thesis: CORE knowledge provenance; CONSOLIDATE runtime controls; reinforces agent governance.
Actor roles: Provider: Cloudflare; participants: verified bot operators; buyers: website owners unverified.
significance: Cloudflare announced and internally deployed ongoing Verified Bot behavior assessment, evaluating robots.txt compliance and response to HTTP 429 rate limits.
assumptions: Behavioral trust bands could misattribute traffic or punish compliant agents.
